title: Luchazi
description: Bantu language spoken in Angola and Zambia
extract: Luchazi is a Bantu language of Angola and Zambia. Luchazi is the principal language of the Ngangela people. Ngangela is a term coined by the Vimbundu traders and missionaries in 18th century to describe the tribes occupying the area of eastern-central Angola.
